title: Knowledge organiser: Revision cycle 1
subject: Computing
source: Seeded from computing/y11 lessons 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35 (Knowledge organiser (pupil PDF))
intro: Revision cycle 1: the big ideas, key words and examples on one sheet. Keep it in your book and use it to revise (cover, write, check).

panels.title: Big questions
points: Everything on your phone, text, photos, a recitation recording, is stored as 0s and 1s. How can two digits hold so much?
Finding a word in a dictionary: do you start at 'a' and read every word? What do you do instead, and why is it faster?
Why does your device have both RAM and storage? Why not one big memory?
When you double-click an app, who decides which memory it gets and how it reaches the screen?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Allah says: 'And do not cause corruption upon the earth after its reformation' (Al-A'raf 7:56). Our use of technology should protect people and the environment.

panels.title: Revision: data representation
points: Sound size = sample rate × bit depth × seconds
7-bit ASCII: 128 characters
Limits: fixed bits restrict range and precision

panels.title: Revision: algorithms, searching, sorting and logic
points: Bubble: compare neighbours, swap, repeat passes
Merge: split to single items, merge in order
Merge is faster on large lists; bubble is simpler

panels.title: Revision: the CPU, memory and storage
points: Stored program: data and instructions in the same memory
CPU: control unit, ALU, registers, clock
Buses: address, data, control

panels.title: Revision: software, programming languages and translators
points: OS: file, process, peripheral and user management
Utilities: repair, backup, compression, defragmentation, anti-malware
Robust software: audit trails, code reviews
Low-level: close to machine code; fast, hard to read

panels.title: Revision: networks, protocols and the TCP/IP model
points: Application: HTTP, SMTP, FTP
Transport: TCP splits and reassembles; checks
Internet: IP addresses and routing
Link: physical transfer (Ethernet, Wi-Fi)

panels.title: Revision: network security, cybersecurity and the impact of technology
points: Environment: energy use, e-waste, rare materials
Ethics: privacy, AI bias, accountability
Law: data protection, copyright, patents, licences

panels.title: Python practical: decomposing a Paper 2 style task
points: A file of madrasah attendance: name, sessions, attended
Output each pupil's attendance %
Flag anyone below 90%; write a report file

panels.title: Python practical: timed task with files, validation and a report
points: Comments explain why
Meaningful identifiers
Consistent indentation and white space
One job per subprogram

panels.title: An 800 × 600 image with 24-bit colour depth. Calculate its size in KiB.
points: Answer: 1,406.25 KiB

panels.title: A 50 MB file (use 1 MB = 8 megabits) is sent at 40 Mbps. How long does it take?
points: Size in bits: 50 × 8 = 400 megabits
Time = size ÷ rate
Answer: 10 seconds

panels.title: Discuss the use of facial-recognition cameras in a shopping centre. (6)
points: Benefit: identifies known shoplifters, deters crime
Concern: privacy; data collected without clear consent
Concern: bias and false matches; who is accountable?
Law: data protection rules on storing personal data
Answer: Balanced points plus a reasoned conclusion
